generators.carrier: representative map C choosing an in-orbit, orbit-constant regime
injective serialization of representative regimes to keys

relations.statement: C(R) is isomorphic to R for every regime R
relations.hypotheses: C lies in each regime's isomorphism orbit
C is constant on isomorphism orbits

relations.statement: serialize(A) = serialize(B) implies A = B on representatives

lemmas.statement: Under R_in_orbit and R_orbit_const, C(R)=C(S) iff R≅S; with injective serialization of representatives, key(R)=key(S) iff R≅S

near_misses.claim: A map C that lands in each orbit but is not constant on orbits yields C(R)=C(S) iff R≅S
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Two isomorphic regimes may be sent to different in-orbit representatives, so equality of C fails for isomorphic inputs

near_misses.claim: Equal keys imply isomorphism with a non-injective serialization
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Distinct representatives may collide on the same key, so equal keys need not imply isomorphism
